notes.title: Playable Demo on June 16th!
notes.content:
PLAYABLE DEMO ON JUNE 16th!


    As a solo developer Steam Next Fest is a big opportunity for me so I submitted Defend Till Sunshine to the Next Fest. Demo will be 15 to 25 minutes long. Your feedbacks are very important to me and Defend Till Sunshine because Defend Till Sunshine will be shaped with its community. 

    Anyways I hope you play Defend Till Sunshine on Steam Next Fest (June 16th) and drop your feedbacks on our discord channel or twitter page.

    Best regards,
    EUZERU
